answer: Cheap keys let one operator flood a cohort with clones. Full attest weight needs a vine of 9 weekly knots: each a 64-byte receipt hash plus a 2.4 POA lock held 6 days, chained and at least 18h after the last. A relic of the latest 4 knots is posted publicly. Every 3h a zephyr sampler draws 2 knots; 5 established peers recompute the chain in 8 minutes. Cost: 21.6 POA locked 6 days and a 9-week wait. Peers replay hashes and lock ages. A late or rejected knot is void and the next lock rises to 3.1 POA; two voids in 21 days slash 40% of remaining locks and freeze weight at 0.15 for 3 epochs.
